questions.title: End-to-End Integration Test Strategy
questions.question: Design a comprehensive integration testing strategy for a microservices-based e-commerce checkout service. The service integrates with: payment gateway (external API), inventory service (internal REST API), order service (internal REST API), notification service (Kafka), and PostgreSQL database. Cover: 1) Test scope and boundaries, 2) External dependency mocking strategy (real vs mocked services), 3) Database setup approach (test containers vs in-memory), 4) Test data management, 5) Transaction handling, 6) Async message verification, 7) Test execution order and dependencies, 8) Performance considerations, 9) CI/CD integration, 10) Monitoring test health and flakiness.
questions.realWorldScenario: Building robust integration test suite for complex microservice with multiple dependencies and integration points
